name: security-audit
description: Audits project security against OWASP Top 10 and CWE, scores findings with CVSS, and produces a validated SECURITY-AUDIT.md report with remediation guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Audit a project and generate a security report
interface.longDescription: Run a scoped, evidence-based security audit against OWASP Top 10 and CWE, score findings with CVSS, and produce SECURITY-AUDIT.md with severity, affected code, evidence, remediation, and deployment readiness. Static and manual review are the default; active testing requires explicit written authorization.
defaultPrompt: Audit this project and generate SECURITY-AUDIT.md
Review this codebase for OWASP Top 10 and CWE findings
